findings.current: Namho had just turned away after thanking him, but his voice faltered without his meaning to.
findings.defect: Namho turns to thank Sama Pyo; he does not turn away after completing his thanks.
findings.rationale: 막 돌아선 and the unfinished thanks place his turn before the attempted expression of gratitude.
findings.replacement: Namho had just turned to thank him when his voice faltered despite himself.
findings.source: 감사를 표하며 막 돌아선 남호가 무심코 말꼬리를 흐리자

findings.current: But what mattered now was who had put bells around the necks of all those black cats—and what their true intentions were.
findings.defect: The plural possessive makes the intentions sound like the cats’ rather than the bell-ringer’s.
findings.rationale: 그 진정한 의도 refers to the intentions of the person controlling them.
findings.replacement: But what mattered now was who had put bells around the necks of all those black cats—and what that person truly intended.
findings.source: 그러나 현재의 상황에서 중요한 것은, 수많은 저 검은 고양이들의 목에 방울을 단 이가 누구이며 그 진정한 의도가 무엇이냐는 것이었다.

findings.current: Only then did the imperial troops lower their bows and weapons, then kneel in unison behind Hong Pyo.
findings.defect: The troops’ prostration is omitted, and ‘behind Hong Pyo’ turns following his example into a position.
findings.rationale: 홍표를 따라 describes following his lead; 부복 adds a bow to the ground after kneeling.
findings.replacement: Only then did the imperial troops lower their bows and weapons, kneel in unison like Hong Pyo, and bow low.
findings.source: 그제야 활과 병장기를 거두고 홍표를 따라 일제히 무릎을 꿇고 부복하는 관군들의 모습에

findings.current: You look old enough that I’ll overlook your tongue being half a foot short, but if you keep refusing, old man, you won’t like what happens.
findings.defect: The literal tongue image is opaque in English and loses Hong Pyo’s pointed tolerance of Sima Gong’s overly familiar speech.
findings.rationale: 혀가 반 토막 난 is a rebuke for dropping the expected respectful speech level.
findings.replacement: You’re clearly older, so I’ll overlook how casually you speak to me. But keep refusing, old man, and you won’t like what happens.
findings.source: 척 봐도 연배가 있어 보이니 혀가 반 토막 난 것은 이해해 주겠지만, 계속 불응할 시에는 노인장도 재미없을 거요.

findings.current: Captain. I think I’m about to piss myself.
findings.defect: It specifies urination where the source leaves what Mujin is about to ‘let out’ unstated, preserving the joke’s ambiguity.
findings.rationale: The same euphemistic wording first accompanies Mujin’s excitement and later returns when he is frightened.
findings.replacement: Captain. I think I’m gonna burst.

findings.current: Piss yourself, my ass. You lunatic.
findings.defect: The narration repeats the draft’s unnecessarily specific interpretation of Mujin’s euphemism.
findings.rationale: Taekyung retorts using Mujin’s own ambiguous verb.

findings.current: Captain. I really think I’m about to piss myself.
findings.defect: The repeated line again specifies urination, weakening the callback between Mujin’s earlier excitement and his fear now.
findings.rationale: 저 진짜 쌀 것 같아요 deliberately repeats the earlier euphemism with 진짜 added.
findings.replacement: Captain. I really think I’m gonna burst.
findings.source: 조장님. 저 진짜 쌀 것 같아요.

findings.current: “I pay our respects to the Marquis of Shangshan!”
findings.defect: The soldiers’ collective response combines singular ‘I’ with plural ‘our.’
findings.rationale: Hundreds of troops shout the line together.
findings.replacement: “We pay our respects to the Marquis of Shangshan!”

findings.current: “And your travel pass as well. Your hair’s bright red from head to toe. You look downright suspicious.”
findings.defect: ‘Hair from head to toe’ is anatomically incoherent and misreads the emphasis that even his hair is red.
findings.rationale: 머리카락부터 emphasizes the conspicuous hair, not hair covering his body.
findings.replacement: “And your travel pass as well. Even your hair is bright red. You look downright suspicious.”
findings.source: 머리카락부터 온통 시뻘건 게 영 수상하기 짝이 없군.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it reverses Namho’s movement, loses a key hierarchy cue, and makes a recurring euphemism more explicit than the source.
